paragraphs: The new C implementation uses a two-tier parsing strategy. The PR description states this fast path covers approximately 99% of real-world floating-point parsing cases, making it highly effective for production workloads.

The design is elegant in that it prioritizes performance for the common case while guaranteeing correctness through the C standard library fallback.

The fast path is deterministic and portable, but the fallback path's behavior could vary. This is the primary technical risk of this change.

The risk here is low, as these are purely subtractive changes.
